contracts.boundary: local fail-closed controller verifies an independent receipt, exact candidate/proposed-merge evidence, GitHub checks, review state, and post-merge push evidence before recording outcome; immediately before merge it re-fetches the proposed merge SHA, tree, and ordered parents and requires them to remain the originally bound identity with parents exactly [base, head]; check rereads the canonical receipt after GitHub checks and reads artifact ZIPs with Python 3 isolated imports.
contracts.assertions: Controller never invokes merge when required evidence is stale, unavailable, altered, unresolved, or the final proposed merge identity moves; check never records merged-and-verified if the receipt is revoked during its GitHub checks; a shadow zipfile.py in the launch directory cannot execute; dry run stays non-mutating and checks preserve frozen intent.

boundaryTest.name: valid apply merges exactly once and verifies push gates

invariant.name: repeated apply preserves the frozen intent and never merges twice

fault.name: guard removal control: bypassing receipt validation reddens the named assertion, restore is green

contracts.boundary: eligibility CLI re-fetches PR head/base and re-reads proposed-merge sha/parents/tree before returning an eligible result, bounds run, job, and review-thread evidence to one explicit first-100 page or fixed page/count/time bounds, and prints only fixed bounded terminal diagnostics.
contracts.assertions: Eligibility fails closed with fixed blockers when head or base moves, the proposed tree or parents change, inventories truncate, or pagination exceeds its bounds; untrusted PR body and GitHub response text never reaches stdout or stderr.

boundaryTest.name: CLI re-fetches head, base, and proposed identity before returning eligible

invariant.name: terminal control PR-body text never reaches terminal diagnostics

fault.name: guard removal control: disabling final revalidation reddens the movement assertion, restore is green

contracts.boundary: acceptance change evidence binds an event-driven push to the actual predecessor commit, keeps pull-request metadata authoritative, and fails closed without an environment-base fallback; the workflow acceptance CLI computes the case from installed dependencies on the real candidate.
contracts.assertions: Push events use event.before and reject missing, null, zero, stale, unknown, or intermediate bases; PR events use pull_request.base.sha despite a competing environment base; declaration base equality and changed-file coverage remain exact; the real acceptance CLI records GREEN for the actual merge predecessor and runs the named rejection and HEAD-parent fault controls.

boundaryTest.name: multi-commit push validates full event.before diff and rejects intermediate base

invariant.name: event-driven push and pull request bases fail closed despite competing env

fault.name: fault control: selecting HEAD parent instead of event.before turns push base RED
